findings.question: 2 Optimus vehicle materials

value.reconstruction: Normal = Append(Append(A, G), sqrt(1 - dot(AG, AG)))  [switch A = true]

findings.note: The DXT5 alpha of VH_Optimus_NORM is read ONLY as normal X (output 4 -> AppendVector.A); G = normal Y. No other node reads A, R or B of that sampler: alpha is NOT gloss/spec/mask. The *2-1 unpack is not in the graph (it is TextureSample unpack / compiled shader: Rendering confirmed from microcode).

findings.question: 2 Optimus vehicle materials

value.formula: Energon = (E + E*pow((sin(sin(fractalMaps.R(panned) + Time*energonSpeed)) + 1)*energonIntensity, energonContrast)) * Lum_Map.B * Energon_Intensity;  Emissive = PowerDown*(EmissivePart*CustClrAlphasMap.B + Energon) -> UpLight/ScanLines/Overshield switches -> Desaturation -> EmissiveColor

findings.note: The red/pink is the AUTHORED Autobot energon colour (1.25, 0.05, 0.05) selected by the master's default static switches (no tagged MIC override). It appears only where Lum_Map (VH_Optimus_SpecPwr_DifLum_EnrGlow) BLUE > 0. All three vector params share the name EnergonColor, so a runtime MID SetVectorParameterValue("EnergonColor") (team colour) would override the selected one - whether gameplay does that is native (UNKNOWN).
